responsibility: Provides the Windows-specific C++ class support for dllimport/dllexport propagation. It decides when member functions, static data members, thunks, vtables, and typeinfo associated with a class should inherit or suppress import/export marking, handling C++-specific cases such as inline members, template instantiations, artificial methods, and thunk exports so the C++ frontend and middle end annotate PE symbols correctly for DLL linkage.
